An unnamed '''Mosciive''' was a member of [[Yojan]]'s squad on [[Simocadia]]. Along with the rest of the squad, he participated in the rescue of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] when the Jedi was captured by a race of unknown demons.
